title: One action row under the last finished answer of any kind: a Help answer and a / command result end with dsh's copy, thumbs, branch and clock like an agent reply, until a new request is sent
steps: S1: Help controller: a question streams and finishes (done carries the answer's turn id); press thumbs up, the server refuses, press thumbs down twice.
S2: Help controller: restore a conversation with a rated answer and a cut question; a question finishes and a bare /help is answered after the chat began, with a fake clock.
S3: answerTextOf for every row state (done, streaming, queued, stopped with words, refused before a word, askBack, greeting, tip).

S4: The plugin source: the row is dsh's ctx.chatLocal.AnswerActions with the answer text, time, anchor to branch at and the rating named by dsh's feedback namespace; a question and the reply to a bare /help are upserted with exchange: true (the suggestions and the tip are not); the start-screen strip wraps each row in a flow item (data-chat-exchange for an exchange) and offers no branch; tracy-brand gives every [data-actions-reveal] button a 1px focus stroke.

S5: Fork 0.2.0-rc.2-tracy.42 (vendor/tracy/deepseek-harness): vitest packages/client/ui-chat answer-actions, chat-view (settled command and /compact), conversation-node-definitions (settledSeq), chat-font-axis-styles (one row out).
expect: S1: the row gets answerId from done; a press shows the rating at once and posts {rating} to /api/assistant/turns/<id>/rating; a refusal puts it back; pressing the recorded rating posts {rating: null} and clears it.

S2: the restored answer carries answerId, rating and at (epoch ms of the stored answer); a bad date carries no at; a live answer's at is the clock when it finished; the askBack row's at is the clock when it was given.
S3: text for done, stopped-with-words and askBack; null otherwise.
S4: every source test passes; the focus rule is outline 1px solid var(--ring) with no box-shadow.
S5: the fork specs pass (CI=true corepack pnpm install --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile inside the submodule first).
evidence: tasks/evidence/answer-actions-2026-10-12/ (before/after screenshots on a real dsh page: agent reply, /help answer, / command result, row kept while typing, row moved after a new request, hover and focus)
fence: Which answer keeps its row out is the fork's CSS rule over data-actions-reveal and later flow items; Help's rating goes through tracy-web's own door, never dsh's message feedback.

tests: rating: the answer id comes from done
rating a row that has no answer id yet does nothing
a restored answer brings back its id, its rating and when it was written
an answer carries the time it finished
the action row shows under a finished answer only
a finished answer ends with dsh's own action row
on the start screen each Help row sits in a flow item of its own
a question and the reply to a bare /help are upserted as an exchange
the action row under an answer takes focus as one 1px stroke
dsh's row sits as far under a Help answer as under an agent reply
